technical-summary: rad0028: under tensor parallelism the DFlash2 selector's chosen tokens are all-gathered and every rank proposes from rank 0's slice, so all ranks verify and accept the same draft. A gfx1201 rank rounded the selector's transition scores differently from gfx1100 ranks, picked another token on near ties, drifted, and read a -1 block-table entry (GPU memory fault). int8 TP3 layout gains the 256-row pipelined-prefill floor.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed intermittent GPU memory faults (and silently divergent speculative decoding) on mixed-architecture three-GPU Qwen3.8-27B int8 serving.
